title: Marriages Prohibition of Wasteful Expenses Amendment Ordinance 1998

sections.shortTitle: Marriages Prohibition of Wasteful Expenses Amendment Ordinance 1998
sections.description:
Short title, application and commencement

ORDINANCE XV OF 1998
MARRIAGES
(PROHIBITION OF WASTEFUL EXPENSES) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1998
ORDINANCE XV OF 1998
An Ordinance to
amend the Marriages (Prohibition of Wasteful Expenses) Act, 1997
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 4th December, 1998]
No.F.2(1)/98-Pub., dated
4-12-1998.---The following Ordinance made by the President is hereby
published for general information:--
1. Short title, application
and commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called the Marriages
(Prohibition of Wasteful Expenses) (Amendment) Ordinance, 1998.
(2) It shall come into force on
such date as the Federal Government may, by notification in official Gazette
appoint.

ORDINANCE XV OF 1998
An Ordinance to
amend the Marriages (Prohibition of Wasteful Expenses) Act, 1997
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 4th December, 1998]
No.F.2(1)/98-Pub., dated
4-12-1998.---The following Ordinance made by the President is hereby
published for general information:--
2. Amendment of section 1, Act
XXI of 1997.-In the Marriages (Prohibition of Wasteful Expenses) Act, 1997
(XXI of 1997), hereinafter referred to as the said Act, in section I, for the
word "two" the word "five" shall be substituted.

sections.shortTitle: Marriages Prohibition of Wasteful Expenses Amendment Ordinance 1998
sections.description:
Amendment of section 3, Act XXI of 1997

ORDINANCE XV OF 1998
MARRIAGES
(PROHIBITION OF WASTEFUL EXPENSES) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1998
ORDINANCE XV OF 1998
An Ordinance to
amend the Marriages (Prohibition of Wasteful Expenses) Act, 1997
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 4th December, 1998]
No.F.2(1)/98-Pub., dated
4-12-1998.---The following Ordinance made by the President is hereby
published for general information:--
3. Amendment of section 3, Act
XXI of 1997.--In the said Act, in section 3,--
(a) in clause
(c) for the full stop at the end a semi colon and word ";or" shall be
substituted; and
(b) after clause
(c) amended as aforesaid, the following new clause shall be added, namely:--
"(d) hold
any reception or function to celebrate marriage after sunset."

ORDINANCE XV OF 1998

ORDINANCE XV OF 1998
An Ordinance to

4. Amendment of section 5, Act
